title: QECGBERT: A Scalable ECG Foundation Model Based on Self-Supervised Language Learning via VQ-VAE Waveform Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2610.33964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI foundation models play a pivotal role in advancing heart disease diagnosis from electrocardiogram (ECG) data, particularly for rare diseases where the lack of sufficient labeled data hinders supervised learning. However, most self-supervised learning methods treat ECGs as generic sequence or image data without exploiting underlying physiological structure. To address this limitation, we propose QECGBERT, a self-supervised ECG language model that explicitly encodes physiological semantics by tokenizing the P, QRS, T, and isoelectric background waveforms. Vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) tokenization is applied to each 12-lead ECG, with tokens enriched by continuous waveform features to preserve morphology lost during quantization without increasing sequence length. This design enables compact BERT masked language modeling with short sequences, improving scalability and reducing computational cost relative to long-seq

translated_title: QECGBERT：一种基于VQ-VAE波形标记化的自监督语言学习的可扩展心电图基础模型
translated_abstract: AI基础模型在从心电图（ECG）数据推进心脏病诊断方面发挥着关键作用，尤其是对于罕见疾病，因为标记数据的缺乏阻碍了监督学习。然而，大多数自监督学习方法将心电图视为通用的序列或图像数据，而没有利用其潜在的生理结构。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了QECGBERT，这是一种自监督心电图语言模型，它通过对P波、QRS波群、T波和等电位背景波形进行标记化来显式编码生理语义。向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）标记化被应用于每个12导联心电图，并通过连续波形特征丰富标记，以保留量化过程中丢失的形态学信息，同时不增加序列长度。这种设计使得基于短序列的紧凑型BERT掩码语言建模成为可能，相较于长序列方法提高了可扩展性并降低了计算成本……
tldr: 提出QECGBERT，一种通过对P、QRS、T波形进行VQ-VAE标记化来显式编码生理语义的自监督心电图语言模型，实现了高效可扩展的心脏病诊断基础模型。
en_tdlr: QECGBERT is a self-supervised ECG language model that explicitly encodes physiological semantics through VQ-VAE tokenization of P, QRS, and T waveforms, enabling scalable and computationally efficient masked language modeling for heart disease diagnosis.
